name: jlcpcb
title: JLCPCB rigid FR-4, standard process
notes: fab_min = the published capability (absolute minimum). design = what pcb_rules recommends for net classes: inside the cheapest tier, with margin.
Via holes of 0.10/0.15 mm cost extra; 0.20/0.25 mm cost extra when the via diameter is below 0.45 mm. A 0.30 mm hole has no surcharge.
Inner copper defaults to 0.5 oz. Specify 1 oz for high-current inner layers (changes the stackup).
Plated-through-hole (pad) to track 0.28 mm minimum, 0.35 mm recommended. SMD pad to pad (different nets) 0.15 mm.
Re-check the capability page before ordering: the numbers change (e.g. LDI mask 1:1 since June 2025).
Recommended above the minimums: via diameter 0.15 mm larger than the hole, 0.2 mm preferred minimum via hole; PTH annular ring 0.20 mm recommended on multilayer at 1 oz (0.254 mm at 2 oz).
Average hole (via) copper plating: 18 um. Use it for via current (pcb-copper), not 25 um.
Copper to a V-cut edge: 0.4 mm (routed and mouse-bite edges 0.2 mm).
Impedance control: an order option on 4 layers and up, +/-10 % standard.
Via-in-pad: filled (epoxy or copper paste), capped and plated; default on 6+ layers, an option below. Open vias in SMD pads wick solder.
